rule: a stack restored after the process died never brings the player back; its title page stands in
patch:
--- a/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/route/Route.kt
+++ b/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/route/Route.kt
@@ -198 +198 @@

rule: an episode that has not aired says Airs and its date instead of its length
patch:
--- a/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/TitleCopy.kt
+++ b/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/TitleCopy.kt
@@ -172 +172 @@
-        val at = releaseMillis(episode.released)?.takeIf { it > now } ?: return null
+        val at = releaseMillis(episode.released)?.takeIf { false } ?: return null
failing: TitleCopyTest > an episode that has not aired says when it airs, in UTC, and does not count as out: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<[Airs Nov 3, 2026]> but was:<[57 min]>
change: fix(android): the viewer journey review's P1, P2 and P3 fixes

rule: the air date is read in UTC, so west of UTC it stays the day the release names
patch:
--- a/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/TitleCopy.kt
+++ b/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/TitleCopy.kt
@@ -174 +174 @@
-        return "Airs " + SimpleDateFormat("MMM d, yyyy", Locale.US).apply { timeZone = UTC }.format(Date(at))
+        return "Airs " + SimpleDateFormat("MMM d, yyyy", Locale.US).format(Date(at))
failing: TitleCopyTest > an episode that has not aired says when it airs, in UTC, and does not count as out: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<Airs Nov [3], 2026> but was:<Airs Nov [2], 2026>
